name: pengepilot-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android shell for PengePilot

scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync && npm run mobile:configure && npm run mobile:assets
